source_standard: WCAG-EM 2.0 (W3C, https://www.w3.org/TR/wcag-em/) evaluation procedure + ACT Rules Format outcome vocabulary (W3C, https://www.w3.org/TR/act-rules-format/)

reference_resolution.rule: sample entries must resolve to real screens/components/tokens in the repo; test must be bound to a specific WCAG success-criterion ID (e.g. '1.4.3') — no orphan references (issue-515 invariant 2).

recomputation.rule: overall verdict = the worst-case result across all cited sample x test outcomes (failed > cantTell > untested > inapplicable > passed), never a standalone summary field (issue-515 invariant 4). result uses ACT's 5-value outcome enum, not EARL's 4-value one, since ACT is the accessibility-specific profile and the W3C spec frames ACT-EARL compatibility as expressibility, not identity (scout-brief.md).
recomputation.checked_by: TBD (follow-up — issue-521 out-of-scope note: per-role recomputation enforcement is a follow-up once evidence from real usage shows which roles need it)

use_when.board_condition: a new interaction pattern or color-token set landed on the branch AND no accessibility record exists yet for it
